question: Mohit starts from Point Y and drives 35 km towards north. He then takes a right turn, drives 83 km, turns right and drives 49 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 36 km. He takes a right turn, drives 76 km. He then turns left, drives 47 km, turns left again, drives 21 km and stops at Point Z. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point Y again? (All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given: 

Mohit starts from Point Y and drives 35 km towards north.

He then takes a right turn, drives 83 km, turns right and drives 49 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 36 km. He takes a right turn, drives 76 km.

He then turns left, drives 47 km, turns left again, drives 21 km and stops at Point Z.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/702ebd674022ddf0ca3ab80cb88e85eb9ec065b5f841437fcd26f5e258c13cb5.png] 

So, He should drive 41 km towards south in order to reach Point Y again.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
